source_claim: The official Oshi no Ko series character, story, and event materials identify ten fictional campaign identities within the title; the actor Han Megumi is intentionally excluded as a person rather than a fictional character.
notes: The official TV anime character/cast materials identify Aqua (whose past life is Goro Amamiya), Ruby, Ai, Arima Kana, Kurokawa Akane, and MEMcho (https://ichigoproduction.com/Season3/chara/ and https://ichigoproduction.com/Season1/staffcast/). Official series event materials credit Piyion and Saitou Miyako as in-series characters (https://ichigoproduction.com/Season3/event/); the official Season 4 story introduction names Kamiki Hikaru in the same title's plot (https://ichigoproduction.com/Season4/story/index.html). The first-party manga publisher page identifies the original title and its story featuring Goro and Ai (https://youngjump.jp/oshinoko/). `han_megumi` is withheld because official cast materials identify Han Megumi as Arima Kana's performer, not a fictional character. `oshi_no_ko` is the Danbooru copyright title form for the property; the exact title has not yet appeared in the confirmed relation baseline, so QA must validate root existence before canonical integration.
